locator_quote: For all cell types, one biological replicate consists of pooled cells from a litter of 3–12 mice.
note: Methods. GEO series text says 8-16 P7 mice per pool for astrocytes: text and deposit differ. Two pools per cell type, so the unit is the pool, not the animal or the cell.

locator_quote: Oligodendrocyte-lineage cell isolation occurred at P17 because it represents the earliest time point when the full collection of oligodendrocyte-lineage cells are present.
note: Results, design paragraph. Neurons, astrocytes and endothelial cells are P7 in the same paragraph; the microglia age is not stated in the text read.

locator_quote: Finally, cells were added to a plate coated with rat anti-mouse L1 neural cell adhesion molecule
note: Methods, neuron purification: L1CAM-bound neurons after depletion of endothelial, OPC and microglia/macrophage cells. Excitatory and inhibitory neurons are not separated.

locator_quote: genes expressed at FPKM values >0.1 are expressed at statistically significant levels (>99% confidence)
note: Results. The authors chose 0.1 FPKM as a conservative expression floor; the lowest replicate value used in the mouse rows is 0.15 FPKM (Pdk4, newly formed oligodendrocytes), so every row is above the floor.

src: Ghareghani 2022 Front Immunol (PMC bucket text, Figs 6 and 7 viewed)
locator_quote: whereas DADA alone did not have any effect
species_system: mouse EAE, female adult, brain homogenate
note: Abstract and Results. The salt (diisopropylamine dichloroacetate) is called a PDK4 inhibitor by the authors; readouts are whole-brain homogenate, not a cell type. Flag: 32 mice in 4 groups of 8 are stated, yet the ELISA ANOVA degrees of freedom are (4, 35); not resolved.

locator_quote: Each group included 8 mice (n = 8).
note: Fig 7 legend. Figure 7 viewed: 8 points per group; active PDC about 10.3 in EAE-PBS against about 5.4 in control.

locator_quote: Induction of EAE mice did not affect PDK4 mRNA and protein expression levels compared with controls, at day 23
note: Results. Figure 6 viewed. Melatonin, not EAE, raised PDK4 about 2-fold; a drug effect on PDK4 level is not a loss or inhibition of PDK4.

locator_quote: reduced by 54.2% from 10.8 ± 1.9 mm3 in the vehicle-only control group to 5.0 ± 1.0 mm3 in the DCA-treated group
note: Abstract. Infarct volume by MAP2 staining, n = 25 DCA and 24 vehicle (Fig 1 legend).

locator_quote: PDH activity decreased significantly at 24 h after HI compared with that of non-HI controls
note: Results. DCA prevented the decline (p = 0.0396), n = 8 vehicle and 7 DCA. Tissue fraction, not a cell type.

src: PMID 34712383, Oxid Med Cell Longev 2021 (PMC bucket text)
locator_quote: the expression of mitochondrial metabolism-related protein PDK2 increased, and PDH decreased in the MCAO cohort
species_system: mouse MCAO, 6-8 weeks, whole brain tissue
note: Results 3.4; n = 6 per panel in the legends. DCA is given after reperfusion; the isoform claim rests on Western blots of tissue.

locator_quote: DCA could protect differentiated HBMEC cells from OGD injury
species_system: human brain microvascular endothelial cells, oxygen-glucose deprivation
note: Results 3.6. The endothelial line is the only human cell system in this paper; PDK2 is inferred from DCA, not manipulated.

locator_quote: knocking down PDK4 in BV2 cells reduced markers related to M1-type polarization
species_system: mouse BV2 microglial line, LPS and ATP
note: Results. N = 3 (Fig 1H legend); a cell line, not primary microglia.

locator_quote: BV2 cells were used as substitutes for primary microglia
note: Limitations paragraph. PDK1-PDK3 were compared in peripheral blood monocytes of sepsis patients in a public dataset, not in brain.

src: PMID 36432491, Nutrients 2022 (PMC bucket text; earlier receipt exists)
locator_quote: the level of PDK2 significantly increased by 83.1% in the seizure-induced group
species_system: rat hippocampus after pilocarpine seizure, adult male
note: Results 3.1. Immunostaining and Western blot; n = 5 per sham group and n = 8 per seizure group (Methods 2.4).

locator_quote: low doses of DCA or pyruvate alone do not significantly reduce neuronal cell death due to seizure
note: Discussion. A single agent alone did not rescue NeuN counts; only the DCA plus pyruvate combination did; the combination hides which agent acts.

locator_quote: Taken together, DCA did not have any anti-convulsant effects in the tested models.
note: Abstract. n and doses not in the abstract; paywalled and not opened.

locator_quote: was slightly proconvulsant in the 6 Hz test
note: Abstract. Worsening direction documented at abstract level only.

locator_quote: PDK2 knockdown increased the ability of SOD1G93A astrocytes to support MN survival
species_system: rat neonatal SOD1G93A astrocytes in culture
note: Abstract. A disease-model astrocyte with low mitochondrial respiration; not a healthy astrocyte; n not in the abstract.

locator_quote: PDK2 is ubiquitously expressed in astrocytes and presents low expression levels in neurons.
note: Declared, not measured in the abstract. Mouse P7 data here (IE008, IE009) show neurons 13.75 and astrocytes 17.27 FPKM for Pdk2, so neurons are not low relative to astrocytes in that preparation.

locator_quote: DCA caused a dose- and exposure-dependent decrease of myelination
species_system: rat Schwann cell and DRG neuron co-cultures (peripheral)
note: Abstract. Peripheral glia, not CNS oligodendrocytes; no isoform tested.

locator_quote: Partial recovery of myelination occurred following a 10-day washout of DCA.
species_system: rat Schwann cell and DRG neuron co-cultures
note: Abstract. Reversibility partial.

locator_quote: Out of the three drugs, only DCA was observed to reduce viral replication in late NPCs treated with DCA.
species_system: neuroprogenitor cells, early and late pools (species not stated in the abstract)
note: Abstract. VER-246608 acted in early but not late NPCs: compound-specific, not class-wide. Endpoint is viral release, not neural function.

locator_quote: PDK1 Regulates the Maintenance of Cell Body and the Development of Dendrites of Purkinje Cells by pS6 and PKCγ.
note: Title of 32487697. Pathway words (pS6, PKCγ, PKB/GSK-3β, FoxO1) point to the 3-phosphoinositide-dependent kinase, not the pyruvate dehydrogenase kinase: INFERENZA at title level, abstracts not opened.

locator_quote: 3-phosphoinositide dependent protein kinase 1
note: Name field of the HGNC record for PDPK1 (HGNC:8816), whose alias_symbol list is PDK1; the REST alias_symbol search for PDK1 returned only PDPK1.
